answer_1.quote: ...We propose a three-stage training recipe that leverages synthetic spoken dialogue generated from text dialogue data... We evaluate SyncLLM in both continuation and interaction settings. SyncLLM achieves synchrony modeling by integrating time information into LLMs so that they can run synchronously with the real-world clock... The model generates spoken dialogue with naturalistic turn-taking, overlaps, and backchannels.
answer_1.outputs: spoken dialogue (audio) represented as HuBERT token sequences with turn‑taking dynamics

answer_2.quote: ...We compute perplexity of transcribed dialogues... we consider median perplexity over the testset... We then compute the Pearson correlation of turn‑taking event durations between the dialogue generations and ground‑truth continuations...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct an evaluation study with 32 annotators recruited via a third party vendor... We adapt the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) protocol (a 5‑pt Likert scale) to evaluate Naturalness (N‑MOS) of turn‑taking and Meaningfulness (M‑MOS) of dialogue content.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators listened to prompt and continuation audio and rated turn‑taking Naturalness (N‑MOS) and dialogue Meaningfulness (M‑MOS) on a 1‑5 Likert scale following the MOS protocol.
